rationale: No existing spec asserts the QueryTypeSelector's own behavior. dashboard-config-promql.spec.js, dashboard-promql-suggestions.spec.js and dashboard-sql-autocomplete.spec.js all CLICK the SQL/PromQL/Builder/Custom toggles purely as setup plumbing to reach the editor/config surface, but none verify: (1) default SQL+Builder selection with PromQL absent on a logs stream, (2) PromQL reveal + auto-select on a metrics stream, (3) Builder<->Custom immediate-vs-confirmation gating, or (4) the destructive SQL<->PromQL re-seed. This is a distinct feature area with its own spec_path in run-context; register it in the Dashboards-Core shard.
